entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I hope you can help. I'm just so disappointed. I need to return a jersey I bought.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to start?
Yes, the name is Sarah Jenkins, and the order number is... VF77812. I've been a customer for years and I've never had a problem before. I just feel awful about this.
Thank you, Sarah. I see you're one of our VIP members; we really appreciate your loyalty. Let me pull up the order... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey. What seems to be the issue with it?

It's just the wrong size. I waited a bit to try it on, I was saving it for a special ride, and it's... it's just way too tight. I can't even move in it properly. I really need to either get my money back or get an exchange for a size that fits.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial for a good ride. Let me just check the purchase date here... I see it was delivered 62 days ago. One moment while I review our policy.
Oh, has it been that long? I was so worried I waited too long. I really needed this to work out.

Not to worry at all, Sarah. I've just confirmed, and for this jersey, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. So you're well within the timeframe. We can absolutely process this for you.
Oh, thank goodness! You have no idea what a relief that is. I was so stressed about it. Thank you, Charlie.

It's my pleasure. I can process a full refund to your original payment method, or I can set up an exchange for the correct size. Since you mentioned it was too tight, would you like to go one size up?
Yes, an exchange would be perfect! A size Large should do it.

Excellent. And as a thank you for being a VIP member, I'm going to waive the standard shipping fee on the new jersey and upgrade you to two-day express shipping at no cost. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label for the original item now. Just pack it up and drop it off, and we'll get the new one out to you right away.
Wow, that's incredibly kind of you. You've completely turned my day around. Thank you so much for making this so easy.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Great. Have a wonderful day and enjoy your new jersey when it arrives!
